team.title: Our Team
team.intro:
Masar Petroleum is deeply committed to upholding its core values in every aspect of its operations. The company’s CEO, board members, and dedicated team of managers, including experts in operations, subsurface management, well engineering, and other critical fields, work tirelessly to ensure excellence.

By leveraging the expertise of top specialists in the industry, Masar Petroleum strives to achieve outstanding results while maintaining a steadfast focus on safety, innovation, and sustainability in all its endeavors.
